name: toolprint
description: Pin and verify the MCP tools your agent trusts. Scan MCP servers and skill bundles for tool poisoning, secret leaks, and silent rug-pulls.
long_description: toolprint is package-lock.json for MCP trust. It connects to your MCP servers, fingerprints every tool, prompt, resource, and skill definition into a committed toolprint.lock, and then catches silent changes (rug-pulls), hidden prompt-injection in tool text, and leaked credentials in configs. This bundle exposes two tools to Claude Desktop: scan (read-only verify) and pin (update the lockfile after review). Scanning runs locally; credentials for remote servers stay in your environment, never in the lockfile.

project_dir.title: Default project directory
project_dir.description: Where relative paths and toolprint.lock discovery start when a scan does not name a directory. Leave blank to pass a directory per scan.

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Connect to MCP servers (or read skill bundles), compare every capability against toolprint.lock, and report tool-poisoning, secret-leak, and rug-pull findings. Read-only.

tools.name: pin
tools.description: Scan, then write the current capability definitions into toolprint.lock as the trusted baseline. Only after review; commit the lockfile afterwards.
